coach.note: On-model Brodie (brodie-character-kit v1): generated with tools/gen_brodie.py from both kit references and the canon prompt, passed check_cream.py (dE 0.0) and a visual check (BRODIE lettering readable, no nose, one mouth, bar brows, flat style), cut out with tools/cutout.py. 1024x1024 transparent PNG.
